atSource: the mtime of the saved red node --test output (date -u -r); the first-written value was not taken from a clock and is replaced here
validatorUnderTest: baseline validate-roadmap.mjs, sha256 df40a6deb9d9b7ba287d5b5a07cdc132bf75f122feb3f060c85e5cb223379bc3 (unchanged at this stage)
testFile: validate-roadmap.test.mjs with the U59 cases appended, sha256 e9567b90e44371f02278c84752e45052d1c66efc776cce738670a5121b52de8a; makeFixture gains an optional third argument editNodes(nodesById) applied to the fixture roadmap before it is written; the 21 earlier tests are unchanged
fixtureShape: gateFixture(over, nodeId = 'R2.camp-3') copies R2.camp-0's pinned gate onto the node and applies over; SOLO = { soloException: true, nonAuthor: false, head: 'a'x40 }; SOLO_RULING = { ruledHead: 'a'x40, pr: 1797, commentId: 5710327985, author: 'fixture-owner', bodySha256: 'c'x64 }

cases.test: 22 U59 (R1) a solo CAMP gate with a head-bound OWNER-RULING for its head passes
cases.refusalQuoted: expected a passing exit, got 1: ROADMAP VALIDATION FAILED (1 issue) / - R2.camp-3 has invalid CAMP GitHub review gate
cases.why: the pin at validate-roadmap.mjs:290 requires nonAuthor === true and soloException === false

cases.test: 23 U59 (R2) a solo CAMP gate without an OWNER-RULING fails, naming the missing ruling
cases.refusalQuoted: The input did not match the regular expression /R2\.camp-3 CAMP review gate declares soloException without a head-bound OWNER-RULING \(PK-camp-review-gate option b\)/. Input: 'ROADMAP VALIDATION FAILED (1 issue)\n- R2.camp-3 has invalid CAMP GitHub review gate\n'
cases.why: refused today for the pin, not for the missing ruling; after the change the refusal names the missing ruling

cases.test: 24 U59 (R3) the pinned CAMP gates pass, and a pinned gate with nonAuthor false or a solo flag with nonAuthor true still fails
cases.assertions: an unedited fixture passes; R2.camp-3 with nonAuthor false fails '- R2.camp-3 has invalid CAMP GitHub review gate'; soloException true with nonAuthor true and a valid ruling fails the same line

cases.test: 25 U59 a solo CAMP gate whose OWNER-RULING names another head fails
cases.refusalQuoted: Input: 'ROADMAP VALIDATION FAILED (1 issue)\n- R2.camp-3 has invalid CAMP GitHub review gate\n' (regex wanted 'R2.camp-3 CAMP review gate OWNER-RULING is bound to dddd..., not the gate head aaaa...')

cases.test: 26 U59 a solo CAMP gate whose OWNER-RULING has a short head and no body sha256 fails as malformed
cases.refusalQuoted: Input: 'ROADMAP VALIDATION FAILED (1 issue)\n- R2.camp-3 has invalid CAMP GitHub review gate\n' (regex wanted 'OWNER-RULING is malformed: ruledHead is not 40-hex, bodySha256 is not 64-hex')

cases.test: 27 U59 a solo gate with a valid OWNER-RULING on a node outside R2.camp-0..8 fails
cases.refusalQuoted: expected a failing exit, got 0: ROADMAP VALIDATION PASSED: 75 nodes, 13 packages, 376 tasks, 40 triage rows
cases.why: the baseline reads githubReviewGate on the nine CAMP nodes only (validate-roadmap.mjs:287-291), so a solo gate on R0.plan is accepted; 376 because the fixture ledger lists no supplement

notRedEvidence: R3 passes on the baseline by design (behaviour-preserving pin); it is kept as the regression guard, not as red evidence
